criteria.reason: Clear sequential steps: consumption assumption, population, multiplication, and error-margin analysis, each explained.
Cups-per-person framed as assumption, but population and European consumption range presented as unsourced facts.
Gives conservative/aggressive bounds, a likely range (15–25 million), and an explicit ±5–10 million error margin.
No sources or verifiable data cited for any input; population and consumption figures are unanchored.

factual_errors: Population stated as ~8.7 million; end-2025 permanent resident population was ~9.13 million (figure is outdated).
Assumes ~2 cups/person/day; reported Swiss per-capita consumption of ~1,069 cups/year (~3/day) implies ~27–31 million cups/day, above the response's entire 15–25 million range.
summary: Response builds a transparent step-by-step estimate with ranges and error margins, but uses an outdated population figure, an unsourced consumption assumption below reported data, and cites no verifiable sources.
